## Six reasons teams choose Waydev instead


Commercial model


### You can buy software without buying services


Code Climate states that it does not offer platform-only access and that its smallest engagement includes quarterly advisory support.1 If your budget has a licence line and no professional services line, that decides the evaluation before anyone opens a feature list. Waydev is a licence with support included.


Speed


### Your own numbers in days


A proof of concept runs against your real commit and PR history before you commit to anything. No discovery phase, no stakeholder interview round, no baseline established by someone else. You look at your delivery data and decide.


Fit


### No minimum organization size


Code Climate is candid that its sweet spot is fifty developers and up, and that smaller teams are better served by lighter tools until scale problems appear.1 Waydev works at thirty engineers and at ten thousand, with the same platform and the same pricing model.


Deployment


### Your commit data never has to leave your perimeter


Cloud or on-premise, with self-hosted Git and ticketing integrations on the Enterprise plan. For regulated industries and organizations with data residency clauses, a cloud-only platform is not an option regardless of how good the reporting is.


Coverage


### The whole toolchain, not the popular part


Azure DevOps, GitLab Enterprise, AWS CodeCommit and Gerrit alongside GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, plus Jira, Azure Boards and ClickUp. Large estates are rarely clean, and the repositories a platform cannot read are usually the ones hiding the bottleneck.


Control


### Metrics you define, data you can take out


Write your own formulas, build the dashboards your leadership actually asks for, and move data both directions through an open API from the Premium plan. Add[WAY AI agents](https://way.dev/) and the[AI Copilot](https://waydev.co/waydev-ai-launch) for AI adoption, impact and ROI measured continuously rather than assessed in a workshop.


One model gives you an interpreter. The other gives you the instrument, and keeps the interpretation in house where the context already lives.

### Where Code Climate is the better call


Worth saying plainly, because a comparison nobody believes converts nobody.


- You have executive sponsorship and a services budget for a genuine transformation programme, not a reporting upgrade.
- You have no experienced developer experience practitioners in house, and a previous metrics rollout died because nobody owned the follow-through.
- You want an outside party accountable for the outcome and carrying the argument into the executive room, not just supplying the data.


There is a third path worth naming. Some organizations use an advisory engagement to define what good looks like, then move to a platform they run themselves once the internal capability exists. Code Climate acknowledges customers who use them as a bridge while building that team.1 If that is the plan, the platform you land on afterwards is the decision that outlasts the engagement.

**Delivery**[Pull Request Insights](https://waydev.co/pull-request-insights/) ,[DORA metrics](https://waydev.co/dora-metrics/) , and cycle time split into coding, review and deployment so the costly stage is visible rather than inferred.


**Health** The[DX module](https://waydev.co/features/developer-experience-dx/) surveys your team and pairs the answers with delivery data, alongside team and contributor insights, benchmarks, and hygiene checks on whether work is tracked well enough to trust the rest.

**Automation** Targets, notifications and burnout alerts to Slack, Google Chat or Microsoft Teams, plus the[activity heatmap](https://waydev.co/features/activity-heatmap/) and[work log](https://waydev.co/features/work-log/) .

## Context on the company


Code Climate spun its Quality product out into a separate company, Qlty Software, and refocused Code Climate on software engineering intelligence for the enterprise.4 The free Velocity for Teams service was ended in December 2023 and those accounts were deactivated on 18 March 2024 as part of the same shift.5 If you evaluated Velocity as a self-serve tool a few years ago, what you would be buying today is a different proposition.


## Switching from Code Climate


**1. Prove it on your own repositories** The proof of concept runs against your real history, so the comparison uses your numbers rather than a demo tenant.


**2. Keep the history** Waydev backfills existing version control and issue tracking data, up to 6 months on Pro and 36 months on Premium, so trend lines start immediately.


**3. Connect the repositories that were out of scope** If part of your estate sits on Azure DevOps, Gerrit or AWS CodeCommit, start there. That is usually where the missing picture was.


**4. Keep whatever the engagement taught you** If you ran an advisory programme, the working definitions and targets it produced carry over as custom metrics and targets in Waydev.

## Common questions


### Can I buy the Code Climate platform without the consulting?


No. Code Climate states that it does not sell platform-only access, and that its smallest engagement includes quarterly advisory support.1 If a licence-only purchase is a requirement, that settles the question before features enter it.


### Is Code Climate Velocity being discontinued?


The product continues. The free Velocity for Teams tier ended in December 2023 and those accounts were deactivated on 18 March 2024 as the company moved its focus to the enterprise.5 Paid subscriptions were unaffected.


### Does Code Climate have DORA metrics?


Yes, integrated into Velocity Analytics in 2023 and correlated with cycle time, unreviewed PRs and PR size.2 DORA coverage is not a differentiator between these two platforms, and any comparison page claiming otherwise is out of date.


### Is SOC 3 a higher certification than SOC 2?


No. A SOC 3 report can only be issued after a clean SOC 2 Type II audit and is a public summary of that same examination.6 Waydev holds SOC 2 Type II and publishes a SOC 3, so our attestation can be shared without an NDA.


### What support comes with Waydev?


A dedicated customer success and adoption team handles onboarding, rollout and ongoing use. It is support for a platform you run, not a transformation programme with a scoped roadmap, and the two should not be priced or judged as the same thing.
